# WD1 · CSKH hôm nay

Group **WD · CSKH & theo dõi** · page · Next.js: **built (U7)** (`/crm`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#queue`
- CSKH screens are drawn by `crm-ui.js` (queue, task and expected-date dialogs, protocol, activity, segments); commands live in `crm-automation.js` (`PemaCRM`).
- `crm-ui.js › queue()` (doctors get `doctorHome()` instead): 4 KPI buttons, left panel "Nhóm công việc" (one button per automation rule with its count), right panel "Danh sách cần chăm sóc" with search `#crm-search`, owner select `#crm-owner-filter`, mode select `#crm-mode` (due today or all dates), table 12 rows per page.
- "Xử lý →" opens the task dialog (`handle('task')`); "Xem protocol" opens WD3; the KPI "Đã hoàn tất" and "Đặt lịch sau CSKH" open WD4.
- Page key `crm` is allowed for roles: owner, care (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"crm\"]"}; it must show `#crm-search`.

## Next.js target
- Route: `/crm` · status: **built (U7)** · U step: U7
- FEATURE-INVENTORY row: `/crm` "Vòng đời khách hàng" (owner U7); test ids: `src/app/(admin)/crm/page.test.tsx`, `src/lib/ops/crm-overview-view.test.ts`

## Required text (keep verbatim)
- Theo dõi lâm sàng và CSKH là hai hàng đợi riêng. Phản hồi cần bác sĩ sẽ được chuyển sang Theo dõi.

## Business rules
- (old web notice) "Theo dõi lâm sàng và CSKH là hai hàng đợi riêng. Phản hồi cần bác sĩ sẽ được chuyển sang Theo dõi."
- "Khách đặt lịch chưa được tính là đã quay lại. Chỉ ghi nhận quay lại khi check-in sau CSKH." (a booking after CSKH is not a returned patient until a check-in).
- "Theo dõi lâm sàng và CSKH là hai hàng đợi riêng." (notice of the groups panel).
- "Việc đã được xử lý hoặc không còn hợp lệ. Tải lại danh sách."
- "Chọn kênh, kết quả, người phụ trách và nhập ghi chú." (task form).
- Booking after a call: the outcome "Đặt lịch" turns the submit button into "Tiếp tục → Đặt lịch" and opens the booking dialog; the task is closed only when the appointment is saved ("Cần lưu lịch hẹn hợp lệ trước khi hoàn tất việc.").

## Differences from the app design
- App C1-C4 show 3 buckets and a short list; the web adds 4 KPI buttons, the rule group list, a mode select, an owner select, paging and the protocol/activity dialogs.
- Canvas: rows use the canvas sample patients (people) with money() amounts; the list shows 7 sample rows, the old web shows 12 per page; the first chip "Tất cả · 72" is drawn selected.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in C1/C2/C3/C4: "Theo dõi lâm sàng và CSKH là hai hàng đợi riêng. Phản hồi cần bác sĩ sẽ được chuyển sang Theo dõi."

## Gotchas
- Every CSKH dialog uses `crm-modal` with its own `#crm-error` line; errors of the commands are shown there, not in a toast.
- The owner filter starts as the account's own care owner ("CSKH Mai Anh"), so the care account sees only its tasks; the owner account sees all.

## Prompt
```text
Build/port web screen WD1 "CSKH hôm nay" (group WD · CSKH & theo dõi, page) in pema-agent/frontend using only src/ui (tokens.json and the kit: Card, Tile, Badge, Button, Field, Dialog, Tabs, TableShell, EmptyState; Notice and FilterChip where the layout names them). Target: Next.js route /crm (built (U7)).
Content comes from the old Pema web, completely: every field, action, status, filter and text in "Layout" must exist, nothing may be dropped (owner rule). Keep the Vietnamese text and the "Required text" sentences verbatim.
Look comes from the app design: tokens and block shapes. Where the old web and the app say it differently (see "Differences from the app design"), keep the old web's UI and leave the choice to the owner.
Do not read prototype/ again: this spec was generated from it. Verify against pema-agent/frontend/visual-ref/old/WD1-1440x900.png at the frames listed in "Frame".
```
